scope: Separate implementation preparation from paid execution and share narrative guidance across modern tasks while preserving historical requests.
riskAnalysis: Longer assignment lifetime grants no paid execution. Existing approval, source, token, lease, cancellation and publication boundaries remain authoritative. Provider descriptions cannot grant permissions or change validation.

threatModel.assets: Source identity, fresh approvals, immutable historical requests and review evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner assignment to controller, model JSON to guarded patch, isolated execution to review.
threatModel.abuseCases: Borrow longer setup lifetime for execution, revive expired task, alter source schema, truncate independent review, change historical request hashes.
threatModel.mitigations: Implementation-only preparation lifetime; unchanged ten-minute approval/run; exact source checks; description-only provider guidance gated to modern contracts.

defects.rootCause: Assignment preparation consumed execution deadline and legacy configuration duplicated its duration assumption.
defects.detectionGap: Fast seeded fixtures did not model owner setup overhead or compare all setup callers.
defects.regression: Five independent assignment-window tests and full phone controller checks preserve revocation and old deadlines.
defects.historicalPrevention: Shared timing definitions and capability-backed UI; legacy metadata and current assignment checks use the same setup lifetime.

defects.rootCause: Phone implementation path bypassed compact prose guidance and produced incomplete schema-ceiling narratives.
defects.detectionGap: Schema validity alone did not prove semantic completeness; historical paths also lacked a shared guidance selector.
defects.regression: All five schemas on three modern tasks change only descriptions; historical request hashes remain exact.
defects.historicalPrevention: Shared narrative inventory guides modern requests only; existing review criticism and all authority checks remain intact.

rollback: Revert reviewed feature changes if qualification fails; retain original history and denial evidence, never revive consumed approvals.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unknown codes/raw errors remain hidden; malformed own records counted unverified.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact task/source/release checks unchanged; history is not execution authority.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing CAS unchanged; same first consent remains idempotent and exact-bound.
negativePaths.cancellation: Connected fixture stops consent after run and asserts revoked grants/paidfalse.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unconfirmed delivery never retries automatically; exact intent retained for readback.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Foreign identities filtered before history validation; service actor gets no history.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No accounting policy changes; no paid inference in fixtures.
negativePaths.partial-execution: FinalChief preserves Auditor rejection; successfulworkflow is not proposalacceptance.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing workflow and journal retained; no new orchestrator or cross-task receipt import.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package or provider changes; one timing source shared by assignment/setup consumers.
proactiveReview.threats: Setup must not extend paid approval or revive consumed authority; schema guidance must not alter protected data.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Original final count-record renewal failed after setup consumed task window; raw prose incomplete at field ceilings.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Expired task, stopped consent, unsupported profile, overflow, malformed output, persistence failure and cancellation covered.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Auditor caught historical request drift; modern guard fixed and immutable hash regression retained.
proactiveReview.recovery: Original agent patch, tests and unresolved reviews preserved and revalidated against unchanged baseline.
proactiveReview.readiness: 180 affected checks plus23 connected checks and12 guidance/history checks passed; final exact-source release verification remains required.
